title: 项目任务工作空间语义 · TSK-13

derived_requirements.rule: 任务首次提交时固定本地或云端执行目标，重试和重启恢复必须复用原绑定，不得静默切换目标或工作空间。

resolution.reason: user-approved WorkBuddy workspace semantics supersede the physical-isolation inference

derived_requirements.oracle: 任务首次提交时固定本地或云端执行目标，重试和重启恢复必须复用原绑定，不得静默切换目标或工作空间。

verification.environment_scope: isolated Electron fixture and provider-neutral server contract
verification.status_reason: reference run has not completed; real cloud provider remains external

steps.action: launch isolated QWork Electron and server contract fixture
capture the pre-trigger baseline for task, workspace and path identity
perform the source-defined scenario trigger for TSK-13 exactly once
observe the post-trigger boundary and assert [REQ-TSK-13-EXECUTION-TARGET] exactly: 任务首次提交时固定本地或云端执行目标，重试和重启恢复必须复用原绑定，不得静默切换目标或工作空间。
restart or retry where applicable and compare the persisted binding with the original

expected_outcomes: 任务首次提交时固定本地或云端执行目标，重试和重启恢复必须复用原绑定，不得静默切换目标或工作空间。
forbidden_outcomes: FAIL [REQ-TSK-13-EXECUTION-TARGET]: evidence contradicts or cannot causally prove the exact workspace oracle: 任务首次提交时固定本地或云端执行目标，重试和重启恢复必须复用原绑定，不得静默切换目标或工作空间。
a user-selected directory is replaced by a task-derived child directory
local path data is uploaded for cloud execution

launch.command_or_tool: npx playwright test e2e/projects-task-controls.spec.ts -g "matches WorkBuddy task target, workspace history, and dismiss behavior"
launch.success_oracle: the delegated local-client workspace sub-oracle passes; server retry and cloud scopes remain blocked
launch.failure_action: repair the delegated Electron route; do not weaken the full execution-target oracle

navigation.locator_strategy: accessible role/name first; IPC and persistence identity for binding assertions

fixtures.setup: case-owned temp home, deterministic fake sidecar and provider-neutral server fixture
fixtures.isolation: no reuse of ~/.qwork, real account or production data
fixtures.cleanup: close processes and remove only case-owned state

observability.correlation: case_id + task_id + run_id + workspace binding identity

cleanup.success_oracle: no case-owned process or temporary state remains

blockers: the delegated route does not execute qwork_server retry atomicity or cloud workspace identity tests
client restart recovery and server retry have not yet been replayed in one cross-platform reference run
real cloud provider and three-platform reference run pending

causal_probe_plan.given: the isolated task has no pre-existing workspace binding and baseline evidence is captured
causal_probe_plan.when: perform TSK-13 exactly once and retain task, run and workspace identities
causal_probe_plan.then: 任务首次提交时固定本地或云端执行目标，重试和重启恢复必须复用原绑定，不得静默切换目标或工作空间。
causal_probe_plan.observation_boundary: durable task and run workspace binding
causal_probe_plan.failure_if: the result is absent, contradicted, pre-existing or bound to a different workspace identity
